decision: Relocate the three #3612 session/AC runtime writers under already-ignored .deft/cache/; keep authz, delivery-attempts, metrics, escalations, and approved-scope at their historical names; couple both shipped ignore lists to imported writer path constants with a fail-closed containment test.

governingRule.description: Couple the ignore set to the writers (derive or fail-closed containment). Prefer relocation or folding over growing the list. Cover TypeScript and Go surfaces. Occupancy is the shared-worktree fence; do not invent a second one. Bound #3612 synthesis 5470462960.

alternativesConsidered.option: Add the three paths to CANONICAL_GITIGNORE_BASELINE and close
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Refuted. The list and the writers stay two hand-kept facts, so the next writer repeats the bug. A list-add is only an acceptable vehicle with the containment test.
ritual-state is rewritten on session start. Mixing would drop the completed marker unless a merge protocol is added. Occupancy already fences singleton .deft writes.

alternativesConsidered.option: Relocate authz, metrics, escalations, approved-scope, and delivery-attempts under .deft/cache/
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Those names are on-disk contracts and UAT/authz paths. Moving them would break existing consumer state without a migrator. Cover them with ignore lines plus the same registry.

whyWinner: Relocation under .deft/cache/ stops new writes from dirtying any consumer that already has that baseline line, including skip-update clones that already ignore .deft/cache/. The containment test, not the three strings, is the mechanism. Historical writer roots stay put and join the registry so the class cannot silently grow.
revisitTrigger: Revisit if a new exported .deft writer path is added without joining RUNTIME_WRITER_PATHS, or if authz/metrics/escalations/approved-scope/delivery-attempts gain a migrator that can move them under cache.
